name: distressor-parallel-smash
description: The classic New-York / room 'explosion' Distressor smash: crush a fully-wet layer to NUKE and blend it under the dry with the built-in MIX. Ratio NUKE (saturated near-brickwall), input 9 (slam), attack 1 (fast — grab everything), release 1 (fast — pumps it up huge), AUDIO = Dist 3 (3rd-harmonic grit on the crushed layer), MIX 30 so the dry transients punch through (measured: mix 30 restores crest to ~17 vs ~15 fully wet). Parallel drum smash / room mic 'whoomph'.
intended_for: parallel drum-bus smash, or a room/ambience mic you want to explode and blend under the close mics
plugin_build: uaudio_distressor.vst3 (UADx native build — RENDERS headless & processes offline, verified changed:true; not the /Components/UAD ….component twin — passthrough offline).
notes: MIX is the built-in parallel blend (0 = dry, 100 = fully crushed). 30 keeps the dry transients (crest ~17) while the crushed layer adds density + grit. Push to 40-50 for more smash, down to 20 for a subtle lift.
NUKE + fast attack/release + Dist 3 = maximum density + odd-harmonic grit. Drop ratio to 20:1 or audio to Dist 2 for a less destroyed version.
Because MIX does the parallel internally, you don't need a separate dry bus — but you can still bus this as a parallel send with mix 100 and blend on the console.
ratio/detector/audio are STRING enums -> preset harness only.
Lower headroom (12) runs the box hotter/denser. A/B loudness-matched — the smash adds a LOT of level.
